event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Chip bounce, defensive tape.
SOXX +2.50% led a split session while XLP -2.07% and XLB -2.01% bled, with RSP -0.33% proving the tape was narrow. Oct ISM manufacturing printed 55.5 vs 54.6 fc (Nov 2) plus Sept factory orders +1.8% vs 1.2% fc and JOLTS 7.523M vs 7.10M fc today — reacceleration data, an upward curve at +0.34%, and a 74% Polymarket hike-in-2026 price keep the Fed hawkish under the surface.

INDICES — VIX 20.8, down from a spike regime but 3.2 above its 17.6 ma20.
SOXX +2.50%, QQQ +0.62%, SPY +0.30%, IJH +0.28%, IWM +0.23%, IJR -0.30%, RSP -0.33%, DIA -0.44%. Large beat small by 0.39pp. Most notable cross-asset: SLV -1.60%, silver's 20d -19.13% the ugliest move on the board.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SOXX 1.3x and IJH 1.3x absorbing volume; SPY 0.8x and IWM 0.7x ignored.
SOXX at 1.3x with price +2.50% is accumulation; SPY's 0.8x on a +0.30% print is low-conviction. QQQ volume data absent from the block, so no read there. Breadth diverges: only 39% advancers, up/down vol 0.95, yet 65% above 50DMA and 26 new 60d highs vs 10 lows — participation is intact but today's tape was distribution beneath the surface.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +1.31%, XLC Comms +1.18%, XLI Industrials +0.95%, XLRE Real Estate +0.07%, XLV Healthcare -0.31%, XLU Utilities -0.57%, XLF Financials -0.64%, XLY Discretionary -0.70%, XLE Energy -0.85%, XLB Materials -2.01%, XLP Staples -2.07%.
Industries: WGMI +11.05% and MSOS +6.90% topped; XHB -2.49% and GDX -1.96% lagged. Flows confirm the rotation — XLF +$1,292mm (98p) and XLV +$640mm (94p) took the biggest 5d inflows, while XLP -$502mm (10p) bled despite a +2.07% 5d. Money is leaving defensives into financials and healthcare; XLK's bounce is short-covering off a -6.85% 5d. Rotation state: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR_vol 1.18 signals real protection demand; SPY's 0.64 reads complacent.
Skew is positive across the board (SPY +11.5%, QQQ +9.1%) — puts are bid. VIXEQ 42.8 versus VIX 20.8 is a 22-point gap: high single-stock dispersion, low correlation, a rotation tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +0.83% and nat gas +1.44% rising despite a +0.17% dollar; gold -0.66% breaking down (-6.02% 20d) is the divergence to watch.
Next FOMC Dec 9: CME FedWatch holds 0%/cut 0%/hike 100.0%; Polymarket 22% YES on no change and 74% YES on a 2026 hike (no-change -4pp in 5d). The market is positioned for tightening, not easing.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 53.3, neutral.
Movers: ETN +7.00%, GEV +6.49%, ORCL +5.85% on $20bn stock/notes pricing, PLTR -1.65% at 2.2x volume (distribution). TAN +3.02% on 3.5x volume with PVH-style juice is the accumulation flag. Watch: TAN (3.5x volume, above 20d trend break), ORCL (2.5x volume, dilution overhang into follow-through), and XLP (98p outflow percentile, 50DMA pivot — the defensive unwind tells you if this is real rotation).
